question: Why is cognitive knowledge primary even in the liberating power of initiation?
premises: Initiation is truly liberating when preceded by cognitive liberating insight.
Without that cognitive basis, initiation's liberating effect is not explained in the same way.
Thus cognitive knowledge plays a decisive role even there.
inference: Therefore cognitive knowledge has primacy even in the context of initiation.
plain_english: Initiation too is truly liberating when it is preceded by cognitive liberating insight; therefore, even there, cognitive knowledge has primacy.
